no_pyproject_toml.summary: Remove Punctuation strips punctuation marks from any submitted text string and returns the cleaned text. Paid plans add the total count and a list of every punctuation character removed.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-ringsizeconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Ring Size Converter translates international ring sizes or millimeter diameters into US and UK standards, inside diameter, and circumference. Paid plans add equivalent sizes for Europe, Japan, Switzerland, and Australia.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-relativetimeformatter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Relative Time Formatter converts Unix timestamps and ISO dates into readable relative time phrases. Choose between short, long, or abbreviated styles to get humanized past or future strings, millisecond differences, and unit breakdowns from seconds to years.

no_pyproject_toml.name: algenta-sdk
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Python SDK for Algenta — self-hosted building blocks for AI applications: governed data queries, simulations, decision memory, and agent runs with approvals

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-regextester
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Regex Tester tests regular expressions against input strings across operations like match, search, replace, and split. It reports compilation validity, syntax error details, execution timing, and structural pattern analysis.

no_pyproject_toml.name: trustmux
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Monitor and interact with tmux/Byobu sessions from your phone

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-recipegenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Recipe Generator creates complete cooking recipes from a dish title or meal idea. Pass any dish name to get structured ingredients with quantities, step-by-step instructions, prep time, cook time, and serving counts.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randomword
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random Word is a random word generator API that selects a random English word from the dictionary on each request. Paid plans add dictionary definitions and ARPABET phonetic pronunciation.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-readingtimecalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Reading Time Calculator estimates how long it will take to read a given text. It calculates reading time based on word count and customizable reading speed (WPM).

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textreadabilityscore
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Readability Score calculates the readability score and grade level of any text across standard formulas. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, Coleman-Liau, syllable and word counts, an average grade level, and a target audience label.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randomjoke
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random Joke fetches two-part jokes with separated setups and punchlines for applications and bots. Paid plans add a joke rating score to evaluate humor.

no_pyproject_toml.name: uulaborchestrator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: General Purpose Orchestrator for Scientific Laboratories. It collaborates nicely with SiLA servers and pythonLab as process description language.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randompun
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random Pun retrieves a random pun and its topic category on every request. Each call supplies the full pun text, with paid plans adding an additional humor rating score.

no_pyproject_toml.name: figaro
no_pyproject_toml.summary: FIGARO: Fast Inference for GW Astronomy, Research & Observations

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randomquote
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random Quote fetches a random quote and its author attribution on every call. Send a GET request without parameters to receive quote text ready for displays, dashboards, or daily messages.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randomdatagenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random Data Generator produces random numbers in any range (whole or decimal, with or without repeats), dice of any size, coin flips, booleans, random strings, UUIDs, and mock names, emails, addresses and dates for application testing. Numbers, dice, coins, booleans and strings come from a cryptographically secure generator. Paid plans can generate batches up to 100 items.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randomusergenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random User Generator produces realistic mock user profiles complete with full names, email addresses, usernames, birth dates, and phone numbers. Paid plans add batch generation, random passwords, and matching AI avatars.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-qrcodegenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: QR Code Generator creates customizable QR codes with support for colors, gradients, logos, and various styling options. Generate professional QR codes for marketing, packaging, and digital experiences.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randomidentitygenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random Identity Generator creates synthetic user profiles with realistic names, usernames, email addresses, phone numbers, and gender attributes. Paid plans add batch generation, birthdates, company details, and AI-generated avatars.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-randomfacts
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Random Facts is a fun facts API that delivers a random fact on every request without requiring any query parameters. Drop bite-sized trivia into apps, chat widgets, and daily notification feeds.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-domainandippinger
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Domain and IP Pinger checks whether any domain name or public IP address is reachable and responding in real time. It returns an alive status and successful round trips, while paid plans add packet loss percentages and latency metrics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-profanityfilter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Profanity Filter is a bad word filter API that scans text for offensive language and masks detected swear words with a chosen replacement character. It returns the sanitized text and a boolean flag indicating if profanity was present.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-periodictable
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Periodic Table retrieves chemical element data by element name or symbol. Responses include atomic number, category, phase, block, standard group and period positions, and CPK hex colors, with paid plans adding atomic mass and thermal metrics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-phonenumbervalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Phone Number Validator checks a phone number and returns whether it is valid, its line type, country, area and time zone, and the carrier its mobile range was allocated to. It flags disposable and VoIP numbers and outputs E.164, international, national and RFC3966 formats.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-passwordstrength
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Password Strength is a password strength checker API that scores how strong a password is. It returns a strength label and score, a breakdown of the character types used, weak-pattern detection, theoretical entropy in bits, and recommendations to improve it.

no_pyproject_toml.name: algenta-mcp
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Algenta MCP server for Cursor, Codex, and other Model Context Protocol clients. Any MCP-capable agent operates the engine — self-hosted building blocks for AI applications — metered and audited like every other caller.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-passwordgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Password Generator creates random passwords, pronounceable strings, and multi-word passphrases configured by length, complexity, and character sets. It outputs generated strings with character counts and configuration metadata.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-partsofspeech
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Parts Of Speech extracts words from text based on grammatical categories like nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Pass any text passage and a category to receive an array of matching words.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-opensourcelicenses
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Open Source Licenses is a software license API that looks up open source license details by name or identifier. It returns SPDX identifiers, canonical URLs, OSI approval status, legacy IDs, and domain applicability for software, content, or data.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-numbertowords
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Number to Words is a number to words API that converts numeric values into written cardinal words and counts whole and fractional digits. Pass any integer or float to get the spelled-out text along with digit counts and locale information.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-worldnews
no_pyproject_toml.summary: World News is a global news API that reads about 275 outlet feeds in 29 editions and 6 languages and merges them into stories: one entry per story however many outlets carry it, ranked by that coverage. Filter by 13 topics, by the country a story is about, by the edition it ran in, or by language.

no_pyproject_toml.name: greeclimate
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Discover, connect and control Gree based minisplit systems

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-mortgagecalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Mortgage Calculator computes monthly and annual loan payments from principal, interest rate, and term. It breaks totals down by principal, interest, property tax, insurance, and HOA dues, with paid plans adding full amortization schedules.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-moonphases
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Moon Phases calculates the current lunar phase, illumination percentage, and lunar age for today. It reports waxing or waning status, Earth-moon distance in Earth radii and kilometers, the next principal phase and emoji representations, while paid plans add custom date queries and the dates of the next new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-moonposition
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Moon Position calculates the moon's altitude in the sky for any latitude and longitude coordinates. Provide an optional time of day to determine lunar elevation; paid plans add custom dates, azimuth, and distance.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-moonrisemoonset
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Moonrise Moonset calculates exact moonrise and moonset times for any geographic coordinate. It outputs ISO 8601 timestamps for lunar rise and set events, with paid plans adding moon phase details and date selection.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-meteoritelandings
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Meteorite Landings searches recorded meteor strikes by specimen name and minimum mass. Each record includes the official specimen name, meteorite classification, mass in grams, and the recorded fall year.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-metadataextractor
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Metadata Extractor is a website metadata extraction API that pulls HTML meta tags from any submitted URL, returning the page title, meta description, author, robots directives, and language. Paid tiers add Open Graph tags, JSON-LD schemas, and favicons.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-marineweather
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Marine Weather fetches offshore weather conditions for any marine coordinates by latitude and longitude. Each response details high and low temperatures, maximum wind speeds, precipitation totals, humidity, UV index, and sunrise and sunset times.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-lovecalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Love Calculator calculates romantic compatibility between any two names, returning a match percentage and summary text. Paid plans add detailed compatibility advice for the pair.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-loancalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Loan Calculator is a payment calculation API that computes monthly loan payments, total interest, and overall loan costs based on principal, annual interest rate, and term length. Include an optional down payment to determine adjusted financing balances and interest ratios.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-loremipsumgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Lorem Ipsum Generator generates placeholder text by paragraph count with optional length limits and standard opening phrasing. Every response includes the dummy copy plus word and sentence counts.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-lotterynumbers
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Lottery Numbers fetches winning lottery numbers, bonus balls, draw dates, and jackpot amounts for major games. Specify Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, or Lotto Max to receive draw results with prize totals, and on paid plans the next draw's estimate and number frequency statistics from the last 100 draws.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textlemmatizer
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Lemmatizer reduces inflected words in submitted text down to their dictionary base forms. It confirms when valid lemmas exist, while paid plans return full word-by-word mappings.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-linkscraper
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Link Scraper is a website link extractor API that pulls internal and external links from any webpage URL in real time. It resolves relative paths to absolute URLs, strips empty fragments, and returns anchor text with internal and external counts.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-languagedetector
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Language Detector is a language detection API that identifies the language of any submitted text string. It returns the primary language, its ISO 639-1 code, and candidate matches ranked by confidence scores.

no_pyproject_toml.name: dlspit
no_pyproject_toml.summary: A multi-domain experiment package: Deep Learning (MLP, CNN, ResNet, RNN, LSTM, Transformer, GAN, VAE), ML ESE Lab (regression, SVM, decision tree, random forest, XGBoost, k-means) Generative AI from scratch in NumPy (VAE, GAN, mini GPT, text-to-image, face swap, music, CycleGAN, chatbot, diffusion) and Explainable AI from scratch (SHAP, PDP, ICE, LIME, Grad-CAM, XRAI-style, Gradient x Input, LRP).

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-leetspeak
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Leet Speak translates plain text into leet speak or reverses obfuscated strings back to standard words. Submit any string with an encode or decode mode to receive the converted text and a count of changed characters.

no_pyproject_toml.name: laser-sdk
no_pyproject_toml.summary: LaserData SDK over Apache Iggy: typed streaming, operational and lakehouse query, materialization destinations, key-value state, copy-on-write forks, and an optional agent runtime with the Agent Data Exchange Protocol (AGDX).
